events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.title: 遗物修补摊
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.description:
你循着敲打声找到一个小摊。一只戴着护目镜的甲虫，正在给断成两截的[gold]遗物[/gold]缠绷带。

“修不好的也别扔！拿来换，拿来卖，都行！”

他拍了拍身旁鼓鼓的[gold]钱袋[/gold]。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.options.TRA: 失去一件可交易的[gold]遗物[/gold]。支付[red]{Gold}[/red][gold]金币[/gold]。获得[gold]{Offer}[/gold]。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_: 没有可供交换的普通遗物。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.options.SEL: 失去一件可交易的[gold]遗物[/gold]。获得[blue]{SaleGold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_TRADE.descri:
甲虫清出一小块桌面。

“让我看看，你带了什么？”
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_SELL.descrip:
甲虫倒出一堆[gold]金币[/gold]，冲你的背包招了招手。

“哪件不想要了？”
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.TRADED.description:
甲虫收下旧遗物和[gold]金币[/gold]，把新遗物推给你。

“好眼光！这件我才刚修好。”

你小心地把它收进背包。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SOLD.description:
甲虫一把接过遗物，把[gold]钱袋[/gold]塞到你手里。

“正缺这个！”

你还没走远，就听见了拆东西的声音。
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.COINS.description:
你捡起一块石头，垫在晃动的桌脚下面。

甲虫停下手里的活，盯着石头看了一会儿，然后递给你几枚[gold]金币[/gold]。

“这个办法不错。”

events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.title: Relic Workshop
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.description:
You follow the sound of hammering to a small stall. A beetle in goggles is bandaging a [gold]relic[/gold] that has snapped in half.

“Do not throw it out! Trade it in! Sell it!”

He pats the bulging [gold]purse[/gold] beside him.
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.INITIAL.options.NO_: No Common Relic is available for exchange.
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_TRADE.descri:
The beetle clears a little space on the table.

“Let us see what you have.”
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SELECT_SELL.descrip:
The beetle empties a heap of [gold]coins[/gold] onto the table and beckons toward your pack.

“Which one are you tired of?”
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.TRADED.description:
The beetle takes your old relic and [gold]coins[/gold], then slides the replacement across the table.

“Good eye! I just finished fixing that one.”

You carefully put it in your pack.
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.SOLD.description:
The beetle snatches up the relic and presses a [gold]purse[/gold] into your hands.

“Just what I needed!”

You have barely left when you hear him taking it apart.
events.RELIC_WORKSHOP.pages.COINS.description:
You wedge a stone under the wobbling table leg.

The beetle stops working and stares at it for a moment, then hands you a few [gold]coins[/gold].

“That works.”
